text:
maya: Quick question — external pen test next week. We need to phase RBAC changes + KMS access for assessors. Proposed minimal plan: create timeboxed assessor role, grant limited KMS decrypt/GenerateDataKey, export logs to audit-bucket with 90d retention, and schedule a short prod window for verification. Comments?

raj: Can you paste the minimal IAM/KMS bits? we should avoid broad kms:* and prefer key policy + condition. ttl for ephemeral role?

maya: Thinking role TTL 2h for prod window, 1h for staging. Example IAM for the assessor role (very minimal):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:GenerateDataKey"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXTERNAL-PT-KEY",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/pt-assessment": "true"}
      }
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-artifacts/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

clara: Ops notes — for staging we can provision the role via our OIDC short-lived credentials (1h TTL). For prod we'll create the role and attach the policy during the maintenance window, then remove it immediately after. Add a runbook entry: test in staging, dry-run presigned uploads, then flip prod.

liam: From compliance: we need logs copied to an immutable audit bucket with 90d retention and object lock enabled. Also we need to ensure logs are scrubbed for customer PII before handing to assessor. Who will do redaction?

devsec-bot: Reminder — all external uploads must use presigned URLs. Example presign cmd: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-artifacts/assessor/scan-output.tgz --expires-in 3600`

raj: LGTM on the policy. Add the Condition to require `aws:RequestTag/pt-assessment` and require MFA/SSO session tag so we can audit distinct assessor sessions. Also add an allow-only for KMS grant creation? limit to grant use not creation.

clara: Revert/playbook snippet for ops:
```
# revert-pt-rbac.sh
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name external-pt-assessor --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/pt-assessor-minimal
aws iam delete-role --role-name external-pt-assessor
# revoke active sessions (OIDC) and rotate temp creds
```

maya: Where should the runbook live and who owns the window? need a named owner for post-test cleanup.

sre-oncall: I can own the prod window. Proposed slots: Mon Apr 7 10:00-12:00 PT or Tue Apr 8 14:00-16:00 PT. Prefer Mon morning.

evelyn: Legal — vendor NDA must be signed before any creds or artifacts are shared. Also confirm scope excludes customer data; if any customer data is in scope we need DPA addendum.

liam: Splunk saved search suggestion to snapshot logs during the window: `index=prod source=kubernetes \"CreateGrant\" OR \"GenerateDataKey\" | stats count by user, host` — run hourly and copy results to the audit-bucket.

maya: I'll add the saved search, the policy snippet, and the presign workflow to the pen-test checklist. @raj @clara please confirm policy + presign process by EOD so we can finalize slot and send NDA to vendor. Thanks! :thumbsup:

raj: acked, will verify policy and add the session-tag requirement today.

clara: ack, will test OIDC flow + presign in staging and post results here.

sre-oncall: I'll block Mon morning in the calendar and tag oncall rotation.

maya: perfect — closing the loop here, will post final checklist and runbook link when ready.
